verdict.rationale: Helicone's GitHub README says it takes one line of code to log requests from OpenAI, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK and more. First-party docs show the OpenAI SDK path in detail ('Add two lines to your existing OpenAI code'). Community users confirm the setup is quick, including a LangChain user who was running in 4 minutes. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party integration docs for LangChain and the Vercel AI SDK (evidence for these is only a README line), and hands-on corroboration of the Vercel AI SDK integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK

citations.quote: One-line of code to log all your requests from OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Gemini, Vercel AI SDK, and more.
Add two lines to your existing OpenAI code to unlock 100+ models with automatic observability
Use the familiar OpenAI SDK to access 100+ LLM models across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more with automatic logging, observability, and fallbacks built in.
